text:
laura: Quick announcement 1: new cohort shadow week next Wed-Fri. I'm organizing 1:1 shadow slots and a live test page. Need to lock primary/secondary for the week and cover any gaps. I can cover Wed morning 08:00-12:00 PT. :wave:
mike: Cool. I'll take primary Mon-Tue daytime (09:00-17:00 PT). Plan: 1) confirm week rota, 2) capture gaps and fallback, 3) post pre-shadow checklist. Runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-basics and https://redwood.internal/playbooks/paging (read before attending).
anita: I'll be secondary Wed-Fri afternoons (12:00-20:00 PT). I also hold the az-west key for private customers if any region failovers pop up.
sam: Heads-up 1: I need Sat early evening covered (handoff at 17:00 PT) 1 — doctor's appt. Can someone pick up 17:00-22:00?
chi: I can swap and take Sat 17:00-22:00. Sam, DM me and I'll update the rota app.
oncall-bot: [automated] Reminder: Shadow cohort test page scheduled 2028-06-14T09:00:00 PT. Read-oncall-runbook v2.2 required.
laura: For newbies, please skim these before your shadow slot: "Paging 101", escalation ladder doc, and tracing quickstart. Enable mobile paging: Settings -> Notifications -> Allow @oncall-bot exceptions.
mike: Runbook quick checklist (copyable):
`````
ACK within 5m: `/ack <INC-ID>`
Open incident dashboard and summary
If customer impact, use customer-comm template
If unresolved after 20m escalate to primary-oncall@redwood
`````
(we'll paste this into the trainee checklist).
anita: Note re: noisy alerts 1: autoscaler spikes cause a lot of false positives. Check `kubectl get hpa -n infra` and `kubectl get events -A --since=10m` before paging other teams. If there's a recent deploy + HPA spike it's often transient.
sam: Shadowing etiquette: always post INC-ID and a 1-line hypothesis before applying a fix. e.g., `INC-20280614-7: hypothesis: stale session cache -> 502s`. Helps audit trail.
laura: Coverage gap: Sun night currently empty. If nobody signs up we'll enable routing fallback to dedicated capacity (ops playbook) to avoid missed pages (costly). Can anyone cover Sun 00:00-08:00 PT?
chi: I can do Sun 00:00-04:00 PT. Recommend updating routing: `fallback: dedicated-high` during any uncovered night.
mike: Shadow flow for trainees: 1) observer on a non-prod incident 2) help triage with questions 3) perform a supervised low-risk remediation (cache flush). Ensure trainee has read-only and a sudo-scoped exception for that command.
laura: Action items (who/what):
- laura: calendar invites for shadow slots (sent)
- mike: confirm sudo exceptions + pre-checklist posted
- anita: put quick checklist in #devex onboarding
- chi: confirm rota swap for Sat (in rota app)
- sam: file PTO so rota shows availability
laura: oncall-bot test: triggering non-prod page now for training flow.
oncall-bot: [automated] Test page created: INC-SHADOW-4001 (non-prod). Acknowledge with `/ack INC-SHADOW-4001`.
new-hire-jess: `/ack INC-SHADOW-4001` 1 Acknowledged, this is my first one 1 what's next in the flow?
mike: Nice. Jess: go to https://redwood.internal/test-dashboard/INC-SHADOW-4001 -> follow "Shadow flow" card. If ready to practice remediation, run this (staging-only):
`````
./tools/ops/cache_flush --env staging --service api-gateway
`````
Wait for verbal go from me (I'm monitoring).
new-hire-jess: Waiting. This is super helpful, thanks.
laura: Handoff template reminder (paste in #eng-oncall when handing off): one-line summary; open alerts; mitigations in flight; pending owners; outstanding follow-ups. Example: `handoff: 1) API 5xx spike (resolved by cache flush), 2) open alert: high-latency on search, mitigation: throttle-outstanding requests, owner: @mike`

mike: I'll add a short note to the runbook about swapping coverage and PTO handling. Also will post the pre-shadow checklist in #devex. If anyone can pick up the remaining Sun night hours please reply.
anita: :thumbsup:
chi: Sat swap accepted, Sun gap partially covered (00:00-04:00).
sam: PTO filed, thanks everyone. See you all in the shadow session. Welcome Jess! :party:
